title: Uncatalogued Audio - best-guess guide (Bais Hamedrash Emunas Yisroel)
note: Companion to pocket-guide-2012.json, covering the audio files that guide does not list. Nothing here comes from listening to a recording or from any outside source (except the rows marked "source": "chassidus-content.com", which are audio added from that site, with their year and part numbers copied from its listing): every value is either read off the file path, or copied from a pocket-guide row when the file turned out to be a copy or a part of a file that guide already catalogues. Each row carries `derived` saying which: "pocket-guide" (inherited from a catalogued row), "dir-prefix" (parsha/zman read off the leading "NN-" of the file name, using the mapping that the catalogued files in that same folder establish), or "filename" (read off the file-name text). `raw_name` is the untouched file name so every guess can be checked, and `note` records any reasoning that was not a straight lookup. Hebrew parsha/zman/year spellings reuse the 2012 guide's own forms wherever it has one.
